before-selling-any-pyramid-tops-initial-.npc: G'day, mate. I'm Simon - Simon Templeton. Who are you?

before-selling-any-pyramid-tops-initial-.player: I'm [player name]. What are you doing all the way out here?

before-selling-any-pyramid-tops-initial-.npc: I've been contracted to retrieve artefacts from the top of this magnificent pyramid.

before-selling-any-pyramid-tops-initial-.player: So, why are you down here and not up there then?

before-selling-any-pyramid-tops-initial-.npc: Well, it's me back - an old injury I picked up in Sophanem has come back to haunt me. I was working for the Museum of Varrock, and the gold I had been given wasn't enough to pay for the carpet rides, let
alone any decent equipment. But that was a long time ago... I can't even lift a chisel right now. There's no way I can climb all the way up there.

before-selling-any-pyramid-tops-initial-.player: How on earth did you get down the cliff face, then?

before-selling-any-pyramid-tops-initial-.npc: That's what set off the injury. I was fine before I scrabbled down that pesky slope. I think it will be a while before I can climb back up again; I must be getting old.
Hang on a second... You look like you're pretty agile and up for a challenge. How about you retrieve it for me?
I'll tell you what, I'll give you 10000 coins for every artefact you get for me.

before-selling-any-pyramid-tops-initial-.player: I'll see what I can do.

before-selling-any-pyramid-tops-subseque.npc: Not bad, mate, not bad at all. Got any artefacts for me?

before-selling-any-pyramid-tops-subseque.text: If the player does not have Pyramid tops in their inventory:

steps.npc: Try harder, mate! It won't be long till some other critter turns up and snatches them out from under your eyes.

before-selling-any-pyramid-tops-subseque.text: If the player has one Pyramid top in their inventory:

steps.text: You hand over the artefact(s) and Simon hands you 10000 coins.

steps.npc: Ripper! Thanks a bundle, mate! Thanks to you I can fulfill me contract. You're a true blue! The boss will be pleased.

steps.player: Glad I was able to help... but who is your boss? I thought you worked for the museum?

steps.npc: Mind your own bizzo, mate. But if you get any more, you know where I am!

steps.player: I have one, but I want to keep it for now.

steps.npc: Careful, mate, people might come looking for a thing like that!

steps.player: Thanks for the advice, but I'll hang onto it for now.

before-selling-any-pyramid-tops-subseque.text: If the player has multiple Pyramid tops in their inventory:

steps.text: You hand over the artefact(s) and Simon hands you [10000 per Pyramid top] coins.

steps.player: I have some, but I want to keep them for now.

after-selling-at-least-one-pyramid-top.npc: G'day, mate. Got any new pyramid artefacts for me?

after-selling-at-least-one-pyramid-top.text: If the player does not have Pyramid top in their inventory:

steps.npc: Well, keep my offer in mind if you do find one.

after-selling-at-least-one-pyramid-top.text: If the player has one Pyramid top in their inventory:
If the player has multiple Pyramid tops in their inventory:

with-pyramid-plunder-artefacts-in-invent.player: I have some interesting artefacts I'd like you to look at.

with-pyramid-plunder-artefacts-in-invent.npc: Bonzer! Let's have a Butcher's mate.
Do you want to flog the lot of 'em?

steps.text: If the player does not have a Pharaoh's sceptre in their inventory:

steps.npc: Fair Dinkum mate, Bonzer doing business with you mate.

steps.text: If the player also has a Pharaoh's sceptre in their inventory:

steps.npc: You sellin' me this gold coloured stick thing. Looks fake to me.  I'll give you 100 gold for it.

steps.player: What! This is a genuine pharaoh's sceptre - made out of solid gold and finely jewelled with precious gems by the finest craftsmen in the area.

steps.npc: Strewth! I can tell a pile of croc when I hear it! You've got the patter mate, but I'm no mug. That's a fake.
Oh, magical powers ... yeah, yeah, yeah.  Heard it all before mate. I'll give you a 100 gold, or some 'magic beans'. Take it or leave it.

steps.player: I don't think so! I'll find someone who'll give me what it's worth.

steps.npc: Suit yerself.. You wanna sell the other artefacts you have?

options.text: Yes, as long as I get a decent price for them.

steps.player: Yes, as long as I get a decent price for them.

steps.npc: Fair Dinkum mate, Bonzer doing business with you mate.

options.text: No, let me think about it.

steps.player: No, let me think about it.

steps.npc: No probs mate. Just give me the items you want to sell and we can do them one by one.
